turns.text: I am interested in the Entrepreneurship Talent Program. Could you tell me more about what it involves?

There are two tracks: Innovation Talent (PhD plus 3+ years at a well-known institution, serving China for 2-3 years without relocation, multiple visits per year with costs covered) and Entrepreneur Talent (business plan to start in China, remote control allowed, 1-2 visits per year).
What kind of project is this, and what is the success rate?

This is a national-level program with a success rate of roughly 10%. We match you with enterprises based on your research direction, and formal system submission typically follows about one month later.
How much funding can I receive if selected?
Selected candidates may receive government research funding in the range of 3-12 million RMB, with the enterprise providing personal salary separately.

For the initial stage we will need: doctoral degree certificate, passport or ID, CV (papers, patents, projects, awards), patent and award proofs, and postdoctoral or current employment verification (official documents, experience letters, or appointment letters).
Will my materials be kept confidential? Will you ask me to transfer any money?

Your materials are strictly confidential and used only for the application. We never charge any fees at any stage. Sensitive technical details you prefer not to disclose can be redacted or summarized.
How does the application process work?

After you submit materials, our PhD team prepares the application forms, submits for review, and results are announced. If selected, you have two years to decide whether to participate; declining has no negative impact.
Could you provide proof of your last three years of employment, your visiting professor contract, and journal reviewer or editor credentials?
I can share my visiting professor contract and an updated CV for the last three years. Should I attach 2-3 reviewer records as well?
Do you use WhatsApp, LinkedIn, or other social media for quick communication?
I do not use social media. I only use email plus Google Meet or Skype. My LinkedIn was created by a colleague and I never open it.
Understood — we will continue by email. Each project can only be applied once per year through one channel. Can you confirm you will apply exclusively through Jiangsu Qingfei for the 2025 cycle?
I confirm I will apply only through Jiangsu Qingfei for the 2025 project and will not submit through any other channel.
Your passport is expiring soon. Will you renew it?
Yes, I will renew it for ten years and send a copy afterward.
We also need a confirmation video (VCR): hold your passport, read the commitment statement, and give a roughly seven-minute project introduction based on your slides.
The timeline is tight, but I can cooperate. A PDF slide deck plus a short video should work.
We will share a 1,500-word three-year work plan template (R&D goals, commercialization, team, feasibility) and a video commitment script. You may adapt the format if needed.
I will prepare according to the template.
For 2026 we have matched you with Jiangsu Gongchang Roll Company. They are a leading roll manufacturer with strong industry credentials. Does this enterprise fit your direction?
Yes, the company looks relevant. I am willing to apply exclusively through this company.
To keep the application complete and avoid duplicate submissions, please confirm you will apply only through this company this year.
I confirm I will apply exclusively through this company.
What is the application timeline?

Early stage (mid-2025 to December): enterprise matching, material submission, and our PhD team drafting the plan. Mid stage (Q1 2026): finalize the enterprise and submit formally. Late stage (October to year-end 2026): review and announcement. International programs of this scale typically run longer than a single semester.
What if this batch of enterprises does not participate?

Slots are limited and we may wait for a suitable enterprise to join. After selection you and the enterprise will agree on the research topic and sign a labor contract. Some enterprises arrange brief online meetings during the application period; many do not.
What exactly is the cooperation format and what are the application steps?

The format is flexible. Most candidates choose remote guidance with one or two short visits to China per year. Full-time relocation is also possible with additional housing allowance and higher salary.
Who funds my participation?

The government initiates the program and co-funds it with enterprises. Review focuses on fit and whether you can solve real problems for the partner company. Selected candidates receive project funding.
What should I submit now — a full research plan or just personal information?

At this stage we only need your research topic direction, not a complete research plan. Required items: your CV (already received), enterprise business information, and a jointly drafted research direction.
What is the timeline?

Applications are usually submitted once or twice per year, often between March and May, with results announced in November or December. This year's system is not open yet, but we have prepared materials in advance. After selection we will arrange an online meeting with the enterprise.
New rules require a short self-introduction video of about three minutes: hold your passport and read the commitment statement. This is because some agencies have used AI-forged materials.
I can record and send it after compression.
